note: BOA-Rwanda's tariff guide (effective 4 March 2026): a retail current account costs nothing to open, keep or close, its ledger fees being free for retail customers; its NYURWA and TUZA packs cost 2,500 and 5,000 francs a month.

sources.title: BOA-Rwanda, Tariff Guide (effective 4 March 2026)
sources.said: BOA-RWANDA TARIFF GUIDE ... Effective by 4th March 2026 ... CURRENT ACCOUNT ... Account opening fee Free Free Free ... Ledger fees Free ... Account closing charges Free Free Free ... Packs NYURWA monthly charge Frw 2,500
